rows.text: Complete browser run finished 239/243. Three reviewed fixture corrections are committed; the fourth is a real-behavior candidate: the UI editor showed the newer label, then both preview and inspector reverted after navigation. Independent reviewer identified unsequenced preview acknowledgements as a possible cause. Preserved full-run evidence and am authoring controlled message delivery before changing production.
